settings.text: Viking Sauna Co. is a U.S.-based manufacturer of premium outdoor saunas, proudly headquartered in Boise, Idaho. We build our saunas from 100% natural cedar and sell directly to customers across North America. Our focus is simple — build exceptional outdoor saunas and deliver them straight to you.

settings.heading: Built For Outdoor Use
settings.text: Our saunas are designed specifically for outdoor use and built with durability, longevity, and traditional craftsmanship in mind. Every model features solid cedar framing, tongue-and-groove wall systems, stainless-steel hardware, and a complete cedar floor and roof structure. These are not lightweight indoor kits — they are professional-grade outdoor sauna systems engineered for real-world environments.

settings.heading: 🇺🇸 Made In The USA
settings.text: From our team in Boise, Idaho, every Viking Sauna is handcrafted and ships directly from our workshop to your door. No middlemen, no markups — just a premium outdoor sauna built with pride and delivered straight to you.
At Viking Sauna Co., our mission is simple... Build authentic cedar outdoor saunas and deliver products forged for the modern Viking!
